equity.level_reason: Results for Black partners are reported by age, gender and sexual-behavior/gender-identity groups (MSM 37%, transgender 38% 'particularly high') and Black vs all index patients (76% vs 73%), but only side by side; the quantified Black–White disparity (eight times) is cited, not computed.

level_alternative.reason: The report frames HIV-related inequities among Blacks and states group-specific contrasts; a reader could treat the stated 'higher' as a quantified disparity.

equity.equity_measurement: Black partners are not linked to index patients' race (could be named by any index patient); priority population missing for 74.6% of named Black partners; transgender persons excluded from gender rows; referent for Black index patients is all index patients including Blacks.

notes: Design inferred as surveillance/descriptive of program monitoring data; no targets are assessed. Priority-population groups mix sexual behavior and gender identity with injection drug use; recorded as SOGI groupwise side by side. No tests or CIs are reported.
view_issues: Summary says 78% of black index patients were interviewed, but text and Table 1 give 76% (76.2%); 78% (77.7%) is partners notified. Table 1 CSV has typos ('24,486)', '1,4084', '812)'); its 'No. (% of total index patients)' for Black is the Black share within each row.
